يخترقوا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَرِقُوا (yaḵtariqū) /jax.ta.ri.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# يُخْتَرَقُوا (yuḵtaraqū) /jux.ta.ra.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
